F:R9-correction.statement: R9 for all small A is false as written; exact repair is that every connected component is filtered, empty allowed.
F:R9-correction.notes: First wrong step: constant singleton diagram does not force nonempty connected A. The repaired theorem is proved.

F:action-calculus.statement: Action criteria inherit to element components; integral acyclicity for all actions equals weak contractibility; P1 forces common successors; P∞ makes simplicial-set colimits homotopy colimits.
F:action-calculus.notes: Covering actions are explicitly induced back by the coproduct construction; no restricted-presheaf covering assumption.

F:sifted-total.statement: Sifted plus P1 of all covariant action components implies filtered; in particular sifted and totally W∞-aspherical implies filtered.
F:sifted-total.notes: Settles H7 and completes the abelian-diagram remark of R9.

F:RAAG-audit.statement: For nonempty connected A, all Cat comparisons, totality plus all group 1-type tests, and totality plus the RAAG tests are equivalent to filteredness.
F:RAAG-audit.notes: R9 naturality, fundamental group, and spectral sequence audited in full.

F:groupoid-poset-tests.statement: Groupoids/Gpd, posets/Cat, and posets/Pos each detect exactly shapes with filtered connected components.
F:groupoid-poset-tests.notes: Explicit bipartite graph and two-middle-vertex square diagrams; finite cellular models machine-checked.

F:abelian-tests.statement: Abelian-group diagrams with colimit in Ab detect precisely filtered A.
F:abelian-tests.notes: Includes derivation of common successors, exact abelian colimits, totality, siftedness; empty/disconnected shapes fail.

F:terminal-tests.statement: Terminal-object-valued diagrams with colimit in Cat detect precisely P∞(A), equivalently componentwise total W∞-asphericity.
F:terminal-tests.notes: Arbitrary transition functors; necessity uses colim B/f(a)=B for final f.

F:other-localizers.statement: All Cat comparisons: W0 permits every A; W1 exactly P1 action criterion; Wn for n>=2 and WZ exactly filtered components.
F:other-localizers.notes: W2 spectral sequence base row split prevents a hidden H3 obstruction.

F:free-monoid-bounds.statement: For free-monoid diagrams with colimit Mon, filteredness suffices and totality is necessary; basis-preserving free diagrams detect exactly totality.
F:free-monoid-bounds.notes: The remaining arbitrary-word-substitution case is isolated in F.10.

F:free-monoid-open.statement: Whether arbitrary free-monoid diagrams with colimit Mon force filteredness remains unresolved; first tested residual shape is Delta_inj.
F:free-monoid-open.notes: Own attack: free diagrams on set actions characterized; RAAG and square detectors require stage relations and cannot be replaced by free presentations.

F:literal-free-colimit.statement: For colimits literally in FreeMon, filteredness is not sufficient; the degree-two sequence has trivial FreeMon colimit but hocolim K(Z[1/2],1).
F:literal-free-colimit.notes: Also full terminal-object category with arbitrary functors has no initial object; smaller-subcategory existence convention not classified.

C:truncated-presheaf.statement: Total W_n presheaf criterion: n-connected E and restricted-action homology vanishing through n-1.
C:truncated-presheaf.depends_on: Bisimplicial comma resolution; collage cone calculation

C:degree-loss.statement: Nonempty cosieves of total W_n categories are total W_(n-1); total W_n iff H_n vanishes. Preorder case is filtered.
C:degree-loss.notes: Unrestricted cardinality; category actions rather than restricted presheaf actions.

C:strict-composition-failure.statement: W_n-dwyerienne sieves fail to compose for every n>=1, with finite first-factor classical Dwyer example.
C:strict-composition-failure.depends_on: Part A finite monoid counterexample; TOTASPH F.26 construction checked
C:strict-composition-failure.notes: X:3 objects/32 arrows; Y:4 objects/138 arrows; all 28204 composable triples checked.

C:remaining-total.statement: Total W_n sieve composition / cosieve closure for n>=2.
C:remaining-total.notes: Exact missing group H_n(BV;Z); first undecided W_2/countably infinite objects. Finite and preorder cases positive; cone-sphere attempt explicitly excluded.

D:dwyer-replacement.statement: Functorial factorization f=qR(f) with R(f) classical Dwyer, q weak equivalence, unchanged source.
D:dwyer-replacement.notes: Countably many small-object stages; no erroneous retract closure used.

D:maximal-class.statement: Largest stable class under cobase change and R(i square endpoint) is all homotopical-cofibration sieves, equivalently formal nerve-pushout sieves.
D:maximal-class.notes: Maximality is relative to the specified modified operation; target changes by a specified weak equivalence.

D:applications.statement: Repaired endpoints give functorial cylinders and homotopy pushouts agreeing with the XII integrated-span construction.
D:applications.notes: Classical Dwyer maps suffice as constructed maps; no literal later invocation of the original endpoint condition found.

D:retract.statement: Classical Dwyer immersions cannot be the entire Quillen cofibration class and are strictly smaller than H.
D:retract.notes: One-object idempotent monoid A; B4 arrows retract C5 arrows; no right adjoint for A->B.

A:finite-height.statement: On any small category with a finite height function strictly increasing on nonidentity arrows, total WZ, total Winfty, total Wn (n>=2) presheaves are precisely representables.
A:finite-height.notes: No finiteness hypothesis on arrows or set values. Uses primitive presentation, skyscraper left modules, and maximal-height support of its kernel.

A:finite-dimensional-semisimplicial.statement: A finite-dimensional semisimplicial set is totally WZ (equivalently Winfty or Wn n>=2) iff one standard semisimplex.
A:finite-dimensional-semisimplicial.depends_on: A:finite-height; covariant Lan along full inclusion
A:finite-dimensional-semisimplicial.notes: Every action on the truncation extends by covariant left Kan extension. The all-dimensional finite-presentation criterion appears separately.

E:path-definition.statement: Exact Ty and path category definitions, with endpoint-preserving numerically monotone type maps
E:path-definition.notes: Definitions verified in supplied transcription and official PDF.

E:necessary-tests.statement: Total categories have common successors and integral affine equalizers of parallel pairs
E:necessary-tests.notes: Independent verification of TOTASPH B.4 and C.11 used in E.6.

E:R8.statement: π0(y\P(Y,y0)) = Hom_{ΠY}(y0,y); q final iff BY connected simply connected; total P implies total Y then
E:R8.depends_on: E:path-definition; word presentation of groupoid completion
E:R8.notes: Full check of R8 without perfect-functor or homotopy-fibre assumptions.

E:point.statement: P(e,*) = Ty is filtered, its integral affinization is filtered, and Ty is total
E:point.depends_on: Terminal empty type; Kan extensions of representables
E:point.notes: The opposite category has different filteredness behavior, F4.1.

E:converse.statement: Converse of R8 is false even for Y=[1], y0=0, with Y itself total
E:converse.depends_on: E:path-definition; E:R8; explicit final functor to S² category
E:converse.notes: All-length witness; finite data machine checked in path_checks.py.

E:total-endpoint.statement: q:P(Y,y0)→Y is totally W∞-aspherical iff Y is a connected thin groupoid
E:total-endpoint.notes: Complete small-category classification, no finiteness hypothesis.

E:strict-cases.statement: Strict q forces |Hom(y0,y)|≤1; for preorders and groupoids strict iff Y equivalent e
E:strict-cases.depends_on: E:total-endpoint; doubled restricted action; subterminal support pushout
E:strict-cases.notes: General strict classification not identified with E.6.

E:retraction-truncation.statement: Walking retraction first path truncation endpoint is strictly total but not totally total
E:retraction-truncation.notes: Universal arbitrary-target proof and complete finite machine check.

E:strict-open.statement: General strict endpoint classification; full walking retraction endpoint is explicit unresolved instance
E:strict-open.notes: Exact remaining weight and restricted-action assertion stated; failed truncation transfer identified.

F4:opposite-types.statement: Ty^op is not filtered although Ty is filtered; its associated preorder is directed

F4:sequential.statement: Sequential fibred integration→strict Cat colimit is a weak equivalence

F4:preorder-chain.statement: Preorder-directed countably cofinal base and homotopy hypothesis do not imply C_N→C equivalence
F4:preorder-chain.notes: Explicit finite base table checked; matches manuscript correction.

F4:passages.statement: Passage audit: integrations, interval pushouts, ind-objects and sequential strict colimits are distinguished

F4:path-comparison-open.statement: Special VII path comparison proved for groupoids and [1]; general case unresolved
F4:path-comparison-open.depends_on: F4:sequential; type projection; contraction of nonempty/support type categories
F4:path-comparison-open.notes: Specific remaining test six-object S² poset; proper Σ also unresolved.

A:semisimplicial-total.statement: The small category Delta_inj of nonempty finite ordinals and increasing injections has filtered integral affinization and exact colimits of abelian diagrams; every component of every covariant category of elements is weakly contractible, so Delta_inj is totally W_infinity-aspherical, although it is not filtered. Explicit augmentation-one affine cones have target [2^(n+1)-2] for source [n].
A:semisimplicial-total.depends_on: Explicit integer coordinate interpolation and gap encoding proved here; exactness of sums and filtered colimits proved here; projective bar resolution described here; cyclic-cover edge-path argument and Hurewicz; comma bisimplicial comparison
A:semisimplicial-total.notes: Reverified construction from supplied TOTASPH C.8-C.10, with the needed affine exactness direction supplied in full. No priority claim. Historical Isbell-Mitchell article body unavailable and not used as a proof. Exact package-relative computation n=0,1,2,3 passed, including all incoming injections and auxiliary recursion cases; unbounded result is proved by induction.
A:semisimplicial-total.manuscript_pages_settled: II ms.36ter conjecture that total W_infinity categories are filtered; unbounded semisimplicial example used in A and diagram-shape comparisons in F

A:projective.statement: Projectivity, or flatness, of Z[H] and nonempty connected U/H imply total integral-homology asphericity; all restricted-action homology is Tor.
A:projective.depends_on: Two-sided projective bar; homological Theorem A
A:projective.notes: Universal in every small target and every outgoing base functor.

A:simplicial.statement: On Delta, total WZ presheaves are precisely acyclic simplicial sets; total Winfty presheaves are precisely weakly contractible simplicial sets.
A:simplicial.depends_on: A:projective; Dold–Kan; finality on fundamental groups
A:simplicial.notes: Includes arbitrary dimensions and cardinalities; emptiness and disconnection excluded.

A:data.statement: Complete 3-vertex/17-edge/15-triangle semisimplicial data, free degeneracy completion, ten-element monoid, and 52-element right act.
A:data.notes: All face, functor and action laws machine checked; tables in JSON.

A:comparisons.statement: Specified weak equivalences M/H -> Delta_<=2/K -> Delta_inj/Kss; finite categories have 52/520, 75/1177, 35/159 objects/arrows.
A:comparisons.notes: Actual natural-transformation retraction and comma contractions; not categorical equivalences.

A:counterexample.statement: Part A is false over a ten-element monoid: H is totally WZ-aspherical, Z[H] retracts from (ZM)^18, but pi1(B(M/H)) is nontrivial and perfect.
A:counterexample.manuscript_pages_settled: XII ms.94–97; XII ms.111; XII ms.113–114
A:counterexample.notes: 52-element act; exact integer matrices independently checked twice. Universal hypothesis is proved, not sampled.

A:posets.statement: On every small poset, totally WZ-aspherical presheaves are exactly subterminal presheaves with nonempty directed lower support; these are total for every fundamental localizer.
A:posets.depends_on: A:projective restricted-action criterion; doubled cosieves; minimality of Winfty

A:R6positive.statement: R6 group/subterminal/visibility cases: group acts are free transitive; subterminal total WZ implies total Winfty; projection pi1(U/H)->pi1(U) is trivial.
A:R6positive.depends_on: Restricted-action criterion; explicit base local systems; Kan extension from full supporting sieve
A:R6positive.notes: Every covering action used is explicitly defined on or extended to the base.

A:enlargement.statement: For the specified finite H and every nontrivial cyclic subgroup of its element fundamental group, no proposed enlargement realizes the requested covering component.
A:enlargement.depends_on: A:counterexample; transitivity of Kan extension; cyclic H1
A:enlargement.notes: Group C means covering fundamental group, not deck group.

A:R6graph.statement: R6 semisimplicial test has H1=Z^28; its incidence graph is a homotopy retract, not a categorical equivalent; the test cannot extend over Delta.
A:R6graph.depends_on: A:data; explicit incidence retraction; full integer nerve homology

A:semisimplicial-tests.statement: All-dimensional semisimplicial total WZ is exactly nonempty connectedness plus positive bar-homology vanishing for the specified countable finite-presentation action tests.
A:semisimplicial-tests.depends_on: A:projective restricted-action criterion; finite presentations; exact filtered abelian colimits
A:semisimplicial-tests.notes: Structural representability classification is bounded-dimensional; no fixed degree cutoff is asserted.

A:census.statement: No acyclic non-simply-connected candidate in the exhaustive stated small-act bounds; all 25 left-regular quotient tests pass for the actual monoid.
A:census.depends_on: Exact category enumeration; reversible Tietze elimination; Smith normal form; A:counterexample
A:census.notes: Monoids order<=4/act size<=3; one-way arrows<=7/each value<=2/total<=4; no global minimality claim.

B:cone.statement: Adjoining an initial base object and singleton fibre makes every totally WZ weight into a totally Winfty weight; restriction can lose total Winfty.
B:cone.notes: Universal all-action verification, not just the identity test.

B:five.statement: All five R5 assertions are false, with explicit finite presheaf, cosieve, one-point attachment, non-discretely-flat sieve and composition examples.
B:five.manuscript_pages_settled: XII ms.94–97; XII ms.111; XII ms.113–114
B:five.notes: Targets: 2/63, 3/66, 4/138 objects/arrows; first factor of composition is classical Dwyer.

B:classes.statement: Exact crossing-weight descriptions and strict containments among classical Dwyer, total dwyerienne, dwyerienne, discretely flat and homotopical-cofibration sieves.
B:classes.depends_on: B:five; restricted-action and simplicial bar criteria; forward cosieve gluing; HORR2024
B:classes.notes: Dwyerienne and discretely flat are incomparable; explicit separators supplied.

B:R2-audit.statement: Strict and total aspherical functors compose for every fundamental localizer; total Grothendieck constructions and total Winfty sieve composition hold.
B:R2-audit.depends_on: Comprehensive factorization; LF1–LF3; explicit collage slices and adjunctions; unrestricted action criterion
B:R2-audit.notes: Includes final-image closure and total elements imply total presheaf. All covering actions legitimately unrestricted.

G:bridge.statement: For any full sieve and its complementary cosieve, the canonical bridge-category integrated-span comparison is a weak equivalence.
G:bridge.depends_on: Mixed-simplex joins; explicit bisimplicial bar; Cegarra2020 Theorem 1
G:bridge.notes: Canonical map checked by a homotopy relative endpoints; empty and infinite cases included.

G:appendix-correction.statement: XIIapp ms.15 has pi1(V0prime)=1 and BV0prime=S2; its subsequent double-cone attachment is S3.
G:appendix-correction.depends_on: Full finite nerve and relator check; double mapping cone
G:appendix-correction.notes: Corrects the printed pi1=Z claim; particular obstruction detects n>=3, not n<=2.

G:passages.statement: Exact passage-by-passage consequences and limited scope for all manuscript locations requested in Part G.
G:passages.notes: Open claims are explicitly distinguished; unnamed future use not identified.
